name: TN Waste Watch goal system
north_star: Help underserved Tennessee communities obtain trustworthy waste-management evidence, usable disposal access, and independently verified corrective improvements.

authorization.release_scope: User authorized publication; parent owns release after independent review/gates. This slice has no deployment or outreach permission.

policy.completion: All acceptance criteria have attributable evidence and independent verification. No percentage based on tasks or documents.
policy.work_in_progress: One pilot delivery slice at a time; at most one independent review alongside it. Ownership is not executor liveness.
policy.review: On a meaningful evidence or decision change, reconcile the current gate; no recurring job has been activated.
policy.stagnation: After two attempts without gate advancement, change approach; after three, record a separate blocker with owner and clearing condition.
policy.priority: Need and unresolved concerns first; feasibility breaks ties; evidence abundance is not need. Missing data does not imply safety.
policy.next_slice_note: These IDs define one integrated pilot-preparation slice, not six concurrent jobs; select county via G2, then localize resource cards.

baseline.note: Research setup exists. Outcomes have not been established; none claimed.

goals.owner: Research owner: this Hermes session; independent reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: Create claim-level ledger for the first candidate and recover its original/current records.
acceptance: Every publishable factual claim has an actual HTTP receipt, source hash, exact quotation/page and event/source/retrieval dates.
Identity, historical/current/corrected/alleged/disputed status, counterevidence and unknowns are explicit.
Independent review checks the actual sources; failed retrievals retain actual status or network error.

goals.title: Verified environmental and community outcomes
goals.owner: Measurement owner: this Hermes session; action owners recorded individually
goals.next_action: Create outcome entries as actions arise; define baseline and follow-up before claiming improvement.
acceptance: Corrective action is credited only with completion evidence and later effectiveness verification; sampling alone is not improvement.
Access change reports actual hours/fees/geography before and after; waste diversion reports baseline, units, period and destination without double counting.
Record the site contribution separately from causation and include adverse effects/burden shifts.
Zero or unknown outcomes are reported honestly; page views and dossier counts are delivery measures, not environmental outcomes.

goals.title: Reachable private-well testing and follow-up
goals.owner: TN Waste Watch research session; local partner/reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: For the selected community verify two feasible laboratory/referral routes, exact analytes, household acceptance, full cost, sample delivery and qualified interpretation.
acceptance: County water card verifies two feasible testing/referral routes, with certified analytes and expiration checks, household acceptance, practical sample delivery/holding times, full household price and necessary assistance. Unknown cost or access may remain in research but cannot pass completion. A single-route exception needs explicit operator approval and a documented barrier/contingency plan.
Affordability or partner pickup proposal names an eligible provider, real capacity, separate approved funding and collection workplan; no assumed free testing.
Qualified adviser selects any site-specific panel; private household data stays protected; abnormal results have a verified public-health referral.
Independent reviewer checks card against archived sources; a test, referral or normal limited panel is not credited as reduced exposure.
County water card includes a verified public-health/urgent referral and EPA-backed immediate-testing triggers and flooded-well precautions, without DIY treatment instructions.
goals.qualification: Statewide pathways researched; county service availability and outcomes not verified.

goals.title: Community service obligations and accountable complaint routes

goals.next_action: Authenticate current controlling law and the pilot county service plan; prepare unsent records, complaint and county-service request templates.
acceptance: Authenticate current statute/rule, local jurisdiction and alternatives before alleging noncompliance; separate minimum duties from proposed stronger service.
Unsent records packet names verified custodian, specific existing records, dates, residency/fee rules and response tracking; no guarantee of seven-day delivery.
Complaint pathway distinguishes dumping, roadside litter, facility conditions and private-property exceptions; preserve safe lawful observation and privacy.

County commission/board proposal identifies authority, requested improvement, recurring funding, affordability, responsible owner and follow-up; local legal review precedes ordinance or citizen-suit guidance.
Permit participation uses the actual notice and its deadline/contact/accommodations; completed remedy and effectiveness checked separately from acknowledgment or vote.
